Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Looking for a dietitian consultation in Johor Bahru? Sit down with ours at KSL City Mall, daily 10AM to 10PM. In the season finale of our Uncle Lim family story, Uncle Lim goes into his clinic follow-up on his own, with three questions written on the back of his card. His daughter waits outside and, for once, asks nothing. Afterwards he picks his next stop himself: a sit-down with our dietitian at Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, who starts with one question about his normal Tuesday. What to bring to your first session: photos of a normal week of meals, your usual drinks, and any plan your doctor has already given you. You leave with two or three small swaps that fit the food you already eat in Johor Bahru. Ask at the counter for Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling, or a Minute Consult with our pharmacist. Session times and charges change, so ask the team for the current rate. Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open daily, 10AM to 10PM.

标题 Title (≤20)
这次，爸爸自己进诊室
正文 Note
这一集是 Uncle Lim 系列的第一季大结局。🥹 月底，我载爸爸去诊所复诊。我手机里存了十四个问题，爸爸只在复诊卡背后写了三个。 叫到他的号码时，我已经站起来一半了。爸爸拍拍椅子，说：“哎呀，三个问题而已，我会数。” 那二十分钟，我没传讯息给弟弟，也没滑手机，就看着那扇门。 他出来时，卡上三个问题都打了勾。我一个问题都没问。他只说了一个字：KSL。 那天下午，他自己去 Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall 找营养师坐下聊。营养师第一个问题是：“Uncle，你平常星期二都吃什么？” ✨ 第一次见营养师，可以带这些： 1. 一个星期的三餐照片（平常的一周，不是最健康的那天） 2. 你常喝的饮料：咖啡店的、瓶装的、三合一 3. 医生已经给你的饮食计划 4. 你自己想问的三个问题 5. 家里负责煮饭的人，一起来更好 🫶 陪父母看医生，有时候最好的支持，是让他们自己说话，我们在外面等。 📍 Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall（新山 KSL 商场 底楼 Lot G-001） 🕙 每天上午10点至晚上10点 欢迎直接到店问药剂师或营养师。
